No live class

A big decision with no first step

Six months of training is a serious commitment. Right now someone wondering if this is their calling goes straight from a reel to the certification page, with no hour in the room with you first.

Two audiences

Nothing sorts future coaches from health readers

Your content serves women looking after their own health and women who want to help others with theirs. Seven links sit side by side, so both land in the same place and nothing shows you which is which.

Reach

The certification only travels as far as a reel

Your last 7 reels ranged from 2k to 33.7k views, and six of the seven stayed under 9k. With no ads running, that’s the ceiling on who hears about it each week.

The women who’d make brilliant health coaches are already watching your reels. There’s no moment yet that lets them raise their hand.

My recommendation

A free live class for women asking “is health coaching my calling?”, that finds your next certification students

You already have low-ticket products, so the class itself should be free. A starter kit on the thank-you page earns from day one and pays for the ads, and the class does the job a reel can’t: it shows people what the work really looks like.

Fixes the missing first step

An hour with you, free, is the easiest yes for anyone curious about health coaching. They see how you teach, and every sign-up is an email you keep.

Sorts your two audiences

Only women thinking about coaching sign up for a class on whether coaching is their calling. Your health content keeps doing its job, and the class quietly separates out your future students.

Makes ads pay for themselves

Starter Kit sales cover the ad spend, so the certification reaches far beyond your best reel, and every new student comes in on top.

The 95%*

Curious, not ready to commit 6 months yet

They join the free class and many add the Health Coach Starter Kit to start practising. The relationship starts with a purchase, and they stay on your list for the next intake.

The qualified 5%

Ready to train now

They show up live, stay to the end and apply on the replay page. The application filters them before a call, and the pre-call emails explain the training, the accreditation and your First Client Guarantee.

*The 95% / 5% split is an industry estimate, not your data.

Meet Dr. Meg

Hi, I’m Dr. Meg Mill

I’m a functional medicine practitioner and the founder of the Women’s Functional Health Institute. I created the Women’s Functional Health Certification to give women who love root-cause health clinical training built for women’s health, plus a clear plan to launch their own practice.

You might know me from my book, 7-Second Switch, my TEDx talk, or my podcast, A Little Bit Healthier. This class is where I share what the path to becoming a coach really looks like.
